liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Turn On Your Lovelight** (5 reviews): Janis keeps trying to draw Pigpen into a raunchy exchange, but he declines to rap; Jerry plays wah-wah guitar during the song [8][10][11][12][13]
- **Attics Of My Life** (1 other source): Uploader finds Attics stunning [1]
- **China Cat Sunflower** (1 review): Early versions of Candyman and the China Cat/Rider pairing appear in this short download [8]
- **Janis's entrance/banter** (1 review): Janis says they might still manage to get it together, and then they do [12]

## The recordings

- **gd1970-07-16.set-2.sbd.ed.32575.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): soundboard; 6 songs; 41 min; rated 4.5/5 by 8 [1]. Said about its sound: Tape hiss is minor, with no dropouts recalled [1]
- **gd70-07-16.sbd.clugston.6485.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 5 songs; 34 min; rated 4.53/5 by 17 [2]. Said about its sound: Tape is crisp but hissy; Reviewer finds the sound great [8][12]
- **gd1970-07-16.sbd.miller.32551.sbeok.flac16**: soundboard; 4 songs; 33 min; rated 3.56/5 by 9 [3]
- **gd1970-07-16.140310.sbd-partial.miller.sirmick.flac1644**: soundboard; 4 songs; 34 min [4]

## Around the show

- Reviewer says this was Janis and Pigpen's last performance together, and she died weeks later [10]
- Two partial recordings carry this date; the one with Janis joining for Lovelight raises questions about which night or set each came from [16]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1970-07-16.set-2.sbd.ed.32575.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by Ed; source: SBD>MR>?>C>CD>SHN [1]. Also: Uploader converted a cassette to disc around 1999 or 2000 and is fairly confident of the lineage [1]
- **gd70-07-16.sbd.clugston.6485.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by Scott Clugston; source: Soundboard [2]
- **gd1970-07-16.sbd.miller.32551.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Master Reel -> Cassette -> Cassette [3]. Also: Same source tape as Clugston's, but analog-to-digital transfer done by Charlie Miller; Clugston worked from a Marantz 500 Pro transfer [14]
- **gd1970-07-16.140310.sbd-partial.miller.sirmick.flac1644**: transferred by Charlie Miller and SIRMick; source: Source: SBD > Master Reel > Cass > CDR; Lineage: CDR > Eac > wav > iZotope RX6 Advanced > iZotope Ozone 5 Advanced > CD Wave > TLH > Flac16; edited and… [4]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Grateful Dead: [Grateful Dead Euphoria Ballroom, San Rafael, Poster](https://www.dead.net/archives/1970/artwork/euphoria-ballroom-san-rafael-poster) [22]
